cohort: Patients undergoing 35 surgical procedures from 7 surgical specialties at a 620-bed tertiary care academic center
finding: Preoperative patient characteristics including insurance, employment status, earlier opioid use, coronary artery disease, acute pulmonary embolism, benign breast conditions, opioid-related disorders, mental and substance use disorders, headache, and previous cesarean section were associated with high opioid use postoperatively.
mod_finding: Patients with a previous cesarean section were more likely to be in the high opioid use group postoperatively (OR 5.10 [95% CI 1.33 to 19.56], p = 0.02).
